title: Zhalia's Mission/Quotes
summary:
"I'm getting too old for this!"
- Hoffman to Sophie Casterwill

"I won't have you bullying Caliban, you scoundrel!"
- Cherit to Incubane

"I know what you're thinking, no Seeker have successfully tame Medusa in two thousand years!"
- Stack to Kiel about Medusa

"Thinking is a waste. Only action has meaning."
- Kiel to Stack

"No enemy is insurmountable if you have the right plan."
- Dante Vale to Lok Lambert after capturing Kiel

"Heh, I hope he can take care of himself!"
- Stack to Kiel after the latter got captured by the Huntik team.
